overview: Umbrella review of published reviews on interpreter use and patient-reported understanding, registered before screening and reported against PRIOR.
population: Reviews of studies of patients who prefer a language other than that of their clinicians, in any health care setting, 2005 to 2026.
exposure: Professional interpretation (in person, video, telephone), tested bilingual staff, and ad hoc interpretation (family, untested staff, no interpreter).
procedures: Library search of four databases and review registries. The analyst and the investigator screen independently; data are extracted per review (question, included studies, outcomes, results, certainty statements). Review quality is rated with AMSTAR 2, primary study overlap with a citation matrix and the corrected covered area, and where reviews overlap heavily the higher-quality or more recent review is preferred by a rule fixed in advance. Model leads, including the 'landmark' trial, are checked by identifier before any use.

outcomes.name: Patient-reported understanding
outcomes.measure: Direction and certainty of review findings on understanding, by comparison
outcomes.why: The outcome the committee cares about most and the least measured (claim c4).

outcomes.name: Interpretation errors
outcomes.measure: Review findings on clinically significant errors

outcomes.name: Satisfaction
outcomes.measure: Review findings on patient and clinician satisfaction

outcomes.name: Review quality and overlap
outcomes.measure: AMSTAR 2 ratings and corrected covered area
outcomes.why: Determines how much weight agreement can bear (claim c3).

feasibility: About 50 analyst days: 5 for searching with the library, 15 for screening, 20 for extraction and ratings, 10 for synthesis.
biasMitigation: AMSTAR 2 ratings by two raters on a sample
Overlap handled by a pre-specified rule
Unverified leads excluded unless an identity check succeeds

biasFlags.label: Double counting through overlap
biasFlags.note: Handled by the citation matrix and pre-specified selection rule.

biasFlags.label: Citation of untraceable studies
biasFlags.note: The landmark lead stays unverified and out of the synthesis.

flags: Reviews as the unit of analysis; no re-pooling of primary studies
parsimony.simplestPath: One search, one extraction form, quality and overlap ratings, one summary table per comparison.

theoreticalFramework: None beyond overview methods (PRIOR, AMSTAR 2, corrected covered area).
summary: Registered umbrella review with understanding as the primary outcome and explicit handling of quality and overlap.
